description: This file contains Python functions and a handler for extracting and setting external ARM toolchain version information, including GCC, libc, kernel, GDB, and BFD versions, based on build environment variables and command outputs.

methods.name: eat_run
methods.description: Executes a command within the build environment, capturing stderr, and returning the output.

methods.name: eat_get_version
methods.description: Retrieves the version string of the external ARM toolchain by running 'gcc -v'.

methods.name: eat_get_main_version
methods.description: Parses the main version (YYYY.MM or release) from the gcc version string.

methods.name: eat_get_gcc_version
methods.description: Extracts the GCC version number from the version string.

methods.name: eat_get_libc_version
methods.description: Obtains the libc version by running 'ldd --version' on the target sysroot.

methods.name: eat_get_kernel_version
methods.description: Reads the Linux kernel version from version.h in the target sysroot.
